Cyclone Arnab has battered Andhra Pradesh and Odisha, uprooting trees, flooding roads and damaging homes along the eastern coast. Kakinada and Machilipatnam are among the worst-affected areas, with residents seeking urgent assistance. Authorities have intensified relief operations, opened rehabilitation centres, restricted fishing and deployed emergency teams to minimise casualties and damage.
